subject: Junior Civil Draftsperson, Brisbane, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Junior Civil Draftsperson role in your Fortitude Valley office, advertised on SEEK (job 94848610). The advert asks for a resume and cover letter and welcomes people finishing school or studying civil drafting, which is the path I am on.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design documented in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as project-in-charge and field engineer on a community hall renovation and subdivision finishing works.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office and site support work and open to discussing a move to Brisbane. I do not yet have Australian consultancy drafting employment, so mentoring on live STP drawings is what I am looking for.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Drawings: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Application for Junior Civil Draftsperson, Brisbane
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Civil Draftsperson role in your Fortitude Valley office, advertised on SEEK (job 94848610). You asked for a short cover letter on why civil drafting and why STP. I want to start by producing clear civil drawings under mentoring, and STP's multidisciplinary Queensland practice with real project drawings from concept through delivery is the setting I am aiming for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

My site experience is from April 2019 to February 2020 in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consultancy drafting employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office and site support work and open to discussing relocation to Brisbane.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would be glad to talk about how a junior drafter contributes on STP civil projects in Fortitude Valley.

checklist: Decide whether you would relocate to Brisbane before applying.
Apply on SEEK job 94848610 with this cover letter and the resume PDF.
In the cover letter keep the two points STP asked for: why civil drafting, and why STP.
Submit while the advert is open.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and method (SEEK).
notes: Direct Brisbane junior civil drafting role for entry and TAFE-level candidates. Apply on SEEK. Relocation is Marc's call.
